summary: The S&P 500 slipped another 0.16% today to 7,664.81, a quiet day as investors waited on Nvidia earnings after the close. Press coverage reports that the Fed's preferred inflation measure, called core PCE, rose 0.2% in July and 3.3% over the past year, meaning prices are still rising faster than the Fed's 2% target and rate cuts remain unlikely soon. Gold edged up 0.24% to 4,649.10 and oil rose 0.78% to 83.00. Tomorrow brings Canadian bank earnings from CM.TO and RY.TO plus weekly unemployment claims.
